title: Topological physics held by the government and aerospace firms
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Topological physics held by the government and aerospace firms, about an unknown time at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I spoke to how put off he said that topological physics could be being held within you know the government

Uh when we spoke to Hal put off he said definitively he said you know um I don't not sure about fundamental physics being tied up in aerospace corporations but he goes topological physics like probably
tellings.difference: Adds that Puthoff was unsure about fundamental physics but thought topological physics was probably held there.
tellings.link_reason: In both, Jesse Michels relays Puthoff saying topological physics may be held by aerospace companies or the government.

as_told.title: Puthoff says physics is held inside aerospace companies

tellings.quote: there certainly is materials knowledge which involves topological physics
tellings.difference: Told by Puthoff himself rather than relayed by Michels, and framed as materials knowledge at aerospace companies.
tellings.link_reason: This is Puthoff's own statement that aerospace companies hold topological-physics knowledge, which the existing story already holds as Michels relaying Puthoff.

as_told.title: Aerospace companies hold materials knowledge involving topological physics

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says that Hal Puthoff, a physicist who has worked on government research into UFOs, told him that topological physics, a branch of physics about the properties of shapes and spaces, might be held in secret by the government and big aerospace companies. In one retelling Michels adds that Puthoff was unsure whether truly fundamental physics was locked up that way, but thought topological physics probably was. If true, it would mean some advanced science is being kept out of public hands.
